products.name: Sharp Conditioner
products.short_description: Coconut + Rice oils for deep hydration and smooth detangling.
products.description:
Hydrating Conditioner

Deeply hydrates and nourishes hair, smooths tangles, and improves softness and shine—without heaviness.

How to Use
• After shampooing, apply to mid-lengths and ends.
• Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse well.

What It Does
• Deep hydration and softness
• Helps repair split ends; strengthens strands
• Improves smoothness, shine, and manageability

Key Ingredients
• Coconut Oil — restores moisture; adds softness
• Rice Oil — strengthens; enhances flexibility
• Vitamins E & B5 — support hydration and protection

products.name: Sharp Sea Salt Spray
products.short_description: Mineral-rich sea salt for natural volume and textured hold.
products.description:
Sea Salt Spray

Create effortless beach waves with our mineral-rich sea salt spray that adds natural volume and texture.

How to Use
• Spray evenly on damp or dry hair.
• Scrunch or style with fingers for natural texture.
• Air-dry or diffuse for extra volume.

What It Does
• Adds natural volume and lift
• Creates raw, beach-style texture
• Helps balance scalp with essential minerals

Key Ingredients
• Dead Sea Minerals — strengthen hair fibers; support scalp balance
• Magnesium & Calcium — support shine and elasticity

products.name: Sharp Shampoo
products.short_description: Aloe + Argan + Rosemary: gentle cleanse with strength and shine.
products.description:
Nourishing Shampoo

Gently cleanse and strengthen your hair with our nutrient-rich formula.

How to Use
• Massage 2–3 pumps into wet hair and scalp.
• Work into a rich lather and rinse well. Repeat if needed.

What It Does
• Cleanses without stripping natural oils
• Strengthens roots and supports fiber repair
• Boosts shine and elasticity

Key Ingredients
• Aloe Vera — hydrates and soothes scalp
• Argan Oil — nourishes; protects against dryness
• Rosemary Oil — stimulates scalp micro-circulation
• Vitamins E & B5 — support resilient hair
• Silk Protein — improves softness and shine

products.name: Sharp Treatment Oil
products.short_description: Nourishing multi-oil blend: repairs ends, tames frizz, adds shine.
products.description:
SHARP Natural Hair Treatment — Nourishing Oil Blend

Repairs and nourishes damaged ends, reduces frizz, and adds healthy natural shine while supporting overall hair health.

How to Use
• Apply 2–4 drops to damp or dry hair, focusing on the ends.
• Use daily as a leave-in, or overnight for deeper nourishment.

Benefits
• Repairs and nourishes split ends
• Reduces frizz; boosts natural shine
• Supports stronger, healthier hair

Key Ingredients & Benefits
• Sunflower Oil — moisturizes; protects from dryness
• Sweet Almond Oil — adds nourishment and softness
• Castor Oil — supports strength and growth
• Coconut Oil — hydrates; enhances shine
• Aloe Vera Extract — soothes scalp; hydrates hair
• Laurel, Cress & Lavender Oils — nourish and revitalize
• Garlic Oil — supports scalp health
• Vitamin E (Tocopherol) — antioxidant protection; shine
